rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a porous sponge used for washing or cleaning.

example.english: I use a sponge to wash the dishes.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 jat1 faai3 hoi2 min4 sai2 wun2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the marine invertebrate rather than the household cleaning material.

example.english: A sponge mainly lives on the seabed.
example.traditional: 海綿動物主要生活喺海底。
example.jyutping: hoi2 min4 dung6 mat6 zyu2 jiu3 sang1 wut6 hai2 hoi2 dai2
